$comment: Configuration for the discipline pack's hooks. Without this file they run on built-in defaults, which for secret-guard and dod-gate means they do nothing at all.
$commentBranches: Matches .githooks/pre-push, which is the authoritative half: git hands that hook the real refs, while the PreToolUse gate can only read a command line.
$commentSecrets: Registering it is the opt-in. There is one credential in this project's life, the tracker token, and it is supposed to live in user-secrets or the environment and never in a file here.
$commentDod: Runs when a session with uncommitted C# changes tries to end. The integration tests are excluded on purpose: they need the local MongoDB, and a gate that fails because Docker is not running teaches people to switch the gate off.
$commentFormat: Verified to pass on this repository before being switched on, so the first edit does not arrive with a wall of unrelated complaints.
